title: mezcala balsensis
intro: Mezcala balsensis, commonly known as Palo de Vaca Muerta, is a plant species native to Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mezcala balsensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the reduction of fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
